findings.quote: The organic layer was dried over MgSO4, filtered and evaporated.
findings.message: The workup identifies the organic layer as the retained phase. Both wash separations should retain the organic phase; its unspecified top/bottom position does not make its phase identity unknown.

findings.quote: The crude product was purified by flash silica chromatography, elution 10 to 60% EtOAc in heptane.
findings.message: The purification method omits flash silica and the specified 10–60% EtOAc in heptane elution gradient. These conditions can be preserved in the supported method field.
